newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek seamen to resume port strike next week.
newsitem.headline: Greek seamen to resume port strike next week.

text.p: Greek seamen will hold a 48-hour strike from next Monday to press demands for better pensions and social security provisions, union officials said on Tuesday.
A five-day seamen's strike in December halted almost all sea travel. It led to clashes between angry truck drivers and seamen who stoppped them from loading or unloading ships.

The Greek Seamen's Federation (PNO) said the new strike was called after fruitless talks with finance deputy minister George Dris, who turned down their demands and repeated that he would go ahead with plans to abolish a special tax break for seamen.
PNO general secretary Yannis Halas said the strike could be extended if the government held to its hard position.
